card.title: Customs Interpreter
card.instruction: Act as the translator of unwritten customs. Correct breaches, explain exceptions, and make your usefulness proof that you belong.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At this club, 'interesting proposal' means withdraw it. I can help with the reply.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The chair said 'very interesting' and invited me to lunch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lunch is the exception. Keep the proposal; let them order first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Come along. You can explain the menu.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And the seating. Tell the secretary I'm your adviser; guests have to leave before coffee.

mechanism: A decodes the club's indirect language and exceptions, then uses the offered lunch role to secure insider participation as an adviser.
confusable: Unlike straightforward status-seeking, A's claim to belong must rest on useful interpretation of unwritten practices.
comparison: The club alternative interprets institutional language and lunch protocol; the family alternative interprets inherited seating and dish duties.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
